text: The first contrast contract is in docs/CONTRAST_CONTRACT.md. Contrast aligns the union of focal keys, preserves failed/missing operands and per-key contribution counts, checks typed method/scale/orientation/policy compatibility, and produces signed output types distinct from bounded input scores. MultiMatch differences preserve five named components. Different data digests are preserved rather than treated as automatic incompatibility. Existing Analysis lacks complete typed compatibility and per-key contribution counts; x-contrast must add the reusable contract rather than parse rendered provenance. This is an accepted implementation target, not a completed production API.
